<view class="space-y-1">
  <accordion type="single" collapsible>
    <accordion-item value="item-1">
      <view slot="trigger" class="accordion-trigger flex items-center justify-between py-4 font-medium">
        Is it accessible?
        <view class="icon-chevron-down"></view>
      </view>
      <view slot="content" class="accordion-content text-sm overflow-hidden pb-4 pt-0">
        Yes. It adheres to the WAI-ARIA design pattern.
      </view>
    </accordion-item>

    <accordion-item value="item-2">
      <view slot="trigger" class="accordion-trigger flex items-center justify-between py-4 font-medium">
        Is it styled?
        <view class="icon-chevron-down"></view>
      </view>
      <view slot="content" class="accordion-content text-sm overflow-hidden pb-4 pt-0">
        Yes. It comes with default styles that matches the other components' aesthetic.
      </view>
    </accordion-item>
  </accordion>
</view>

<view
  class="accordion-item border-b {{className}}"
  data-slot="accordion-item"
  data-state="{{expanded ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
>
  <view class="accordion-header flex">
    <view 
      class="accordion-trigger flex flex-1 items-center justify-between py-4 font-medium transition-all hover:underline  {{disabled ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''}}"
      data-slot="accordion-trigger"
      bindtap="onTap"
      data-state="{{expanded ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
      aria-expanded="{{expanded ? 'true' : 'false'}}"
    >
      <slot name="trigger"></slot>
      <view class="icon-container {{expanded ? iconExpandedClass : ''}} transition-transform duration-200">
         <slot name="icon">
           <!-- Ideally use an icon component or svg here -->
           <view class="h-4 w-4">⌄</view> 
         </slot>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
  <view 
    class="accordion-content overflow-hidden text-sm transition-all"
    data-slot="accordion-content"
    data-state="{{expanded ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
    style="{{expanded ? '' : 'height: 0; padding-bottom: 0;'}}"
  >
    <view class="pb-4 pt-0">
      <slot name="content"></slot>
      <slot></slot>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
